subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's worth analyzing in these travel-expense records.

judge.implied_focus: The nature/classification of the underlying asset or configuration item (CI) behind each expense record -- i.e., what kind of asset each 'travel-expense' record actually represents and how it was recorded.

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: Directly classifies the asset type behind the record; a core facet of the CI/asset focus.

per_column.name: ci_form_factor
per_column.rationale: Refines asset classification by physical/logical form factor; strongly on-focus.

per_column.name: travel_context
per_column.rationale: Flags whether the asset is travel-related, a coherent sub-facet of asset nature revealing that most records aren't actually travel.

per_column.name: asset_brand
per_column.rationale: Vendor/brand attribute of the asset; a natural predictor/attribute of the asset focus.

per_column.name: record_action_type
per_column.rationale: Describes the lifecycle action producing the record; relates to how the CI came to exist, adjacent to the focus.

per_column.name: creation_method
per_column.rationale: Manual vs automated is a process-provenance attribute of the record, not of the asset's nature; drifts from the focus.

per_column.name: processing_lag_band
per_column.rationale: Processing latency is a workflow/timeliness metric unrelated to asset classification.

per_column.name: source_id_present
per_column.rationale: A generic data-completeness flag; mechanical and not centred on the asset focus.

per_column.name: department_group
per_column.rationale: Organizational dimension; useful for slicing but not part of the asset-nature focus.

per_column.name: is_miscellaneous_ci
per_column.rationale: Classifies whether the CI is a residual/uncategorized asset; a facet of the asset-nature focus.

judge.rationale: A plurality of columns (asset_category, ci_form_factor, travel_context, asset_brand, is_miscellaneous_ci, and arguably record_action_type) converge on a genuinely data-inferable focus: the true nature of the asset/CI behind each 'travel expense', surfacing the striking finding that most records are hardware endpoints rather than travel. This is a coherent, actionable insight an analyst could pursue (mislabelled expense taxonomy, procurement vs travel spend). However coherence is diluted by a cluster of off-focus process/provenance/quality columns (creation_method, processing_lag_band, source_id_present, department_group) that form a second, unrelated theme, making the set partly a grab-bag rather than a tight facet structure. Granularity is reasonable, but the two competing themes prevent a high structure score.
